cohort: The study included 36,703 nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex patients who delivered between January 2019 and December 2022.
finding: In vitro fertility was associated with 1.99 times the odds of cesarean delivery compared to non-in vitro fertility pregnancies in nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex pregnancies.
mod_finding: In vitro fertility is associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery (a mode of birth) in nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex pregnancies.
